# openwebui_oauth_config (Resource)

Manages Open WebUI's single generic OIDC provider configuration and cross-cutting OAuth behavior (role/group mapping, domain allowlist, claims). Configuring per-provider (Google/Microsoft/GitHub) client credentials is done via environment variables, not this resource.

~> **Requires Open WebUI v0.10.0+.** This endpoint did not exist in earlier releases.

~> This resource applies a partial update: only attributes that have a value in the plan are sent, and everything else is left untouched on the server. Removing an attribute from your configuration therefore does not reset it to its default; set it to the value you want instead (an empty string clears a string attribute). Open WebUI cannot store null for these settings.

~> `oauth_client_secret` is stored in Terraform state because Open WebUI returns it in plain text. Protect your state accordingly.

~> Be careful with `oauth_auto_redirect` and `enable_oauth`: a misconfigured provider combined with auto-redirect can lock password-based admins out of the sign-in page.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "oidc_client_secret" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

# Requires Open WebUI v0.10.0 or later.
resource "openwebui_oauth_config" "example" {
  oauth_provider_name = "Corporate SSO"
  openid_provider_url = "https://idp.example.com/.well-known/openid-configuration"
  oauth_client_id     = "open-webui"
  oauth_client_secret = var.oidc_client_secret
  oauth_scopes        = "openid email profile"

  enable_oauth_signup   = true
  oauth_allowed_domains = "example.com,example.org"

  enable_oauth_role_management = true
  oauth_roles_claim            = "roles"
  oauth_admin_roles            = "openwebui-admin"
  oauth_allowed_roles          = "openwebui-user,openwebui-admin"

  enable_oauth_group_management = true
  enable_oauth_group_creation   = false
  oauth_group_claim             = "groups"
  oauth_group_default_share     = "members"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `enable_oauth` (Boolean) Master switch for OAuth login. Server default: `true`. Added in Open WebUI v0.11.0; on v0.10.x the attribute is read back as null and writes are ignored.
- `enable_oauth_group_creation` (Boolean) Whether groups found in the claim are created when missing. Server default: `false`.
- `enable_oauth_group_management` (Boolean) Whether group membership is synchronised from the provider's group claim. Server default: `false`.
- `enable_oauth_role_management` (Boolean) Whether roles are mapped from the provider's roles claim. Server default: `false`.
- `enable_oauth_signup` (Boolean) Whether new users may sign up through OAuth. Server default: `false`.
- `oauth_admin_roles` (String) Comma-separated provider roles that map to the Open WebUI admin role. Items must be non-empty with no leading or trailing whitespace. Server default: `admin`.
- `oauth_allowed_domains` (String) Comma-separated list of allowed email domains; `*` allows all. Items must be non-empty with no leading or trailing whitespace, because the server trims and re-joins them with plain commas. An empty string stores an empty list. Server default: `*`.
- `oauth_allowed_roles` (String) Comma-separated provider roles allowed to sign in. Items must be non-empty with no leading or trailing whitespace. Server default: `user,admin`.
- `oauth_audience` (String) Audience sent to the provider. Empty means none.
- `oauth_auto_redirect` (Boolean) Whether the sign-in page redirects straight to the OAuth provider. Enabling it can lock password-based admins out of the UI. Server default: `false`.
- `oauth_blocked_groups` (String) Blocked OAuth groups, stored as a string (the server default is the JSON list text `[]`).
- `oauth_client_id` (String) OAuth client ID of the generic OIDC provider.
- `oauth_client_secret` (String, Sensitive) OAuth client secret of the generic OIDC provider. Sensitive. Open WebUI returns it in plain text from its read endpoint, so it is also kept in Terraform state.
- `oauth_client_timeout` (String) HTTP client timeout in seconds, as a whole-number string without leading zeros, or an empty string for none. Server default: empty string.
- `oauth_code_challenge_method` (String) PKCE code challenge method. Only `S256` is supported by Open WebUI; an empty string disables PKCE. Null until set.
- `oauth_email_claim` (String) Claim that carries the user's email. Server default: `email`.
- `oauth_group_claim` (String) Claim that carries the user's groups. Server default: `groups`.
- `oauth_group_default_share` (String) Default sharing for groups created from OAuth claims. One of `true`, `false` or `members`. The server stores a boolean for `true`/`false` and the string `members`; the attribute is always a string in Terraform. Server default: `true`.
- `oauth_merge_accounts_by_email` (Boolean) Whether an OAuth login is merged into an existing local account with the same email. Only enable this for identity providers that verify email ownership. Server default: `false`.
- `oauth_picture_claim` (String) Claim that carries the user's profile picture URL. Server default: `picture`.
- `oauth_provider_name` (String) Display name of the OIDC provider on the sign-in button. Server default: `SSO`.
- `oauth_refresh_token_include_scope` (Boolean) Whether the scope is included in refresh-token requests. Server default: `false`.
- `oauth_roles_claim` (String) Claim that carries the user's roles. Server default: `roles`.
- `oauth_scopes` (String) Space-separated scopes requested from the provider. Server default: `openid email profile`.
- `oauth_sub_claim` (String) Claim used as the subject identifier. Null until set (the provider default `sub` applies).
- `oauth_timeout` (String) HTTP timeout in seconds for provider requests, as a whole-number string without leading zeros (for example `"30"`), or an empty string for no explicit timeout. The server accepts an integer or a string; Terraform always sees a string. Server default: empty string.
- `oauth_token_endpoint_auth_method` (String) Client authentication method at the token endpoint (for example `client_secret_post`). Null until set.
- `oauth_update_email_on_login` (Boolean) Whether the user's email is refreshed from the provider on every login. Server default: `false`.
- `oauth_update_name_on_login` (Boolean) Whether the user's name is refreshed on every login. Server default: `false`.
- `oauth_update_picture_on_login` (Boolean) Whether the user's picture is refreshed on every login. Server default: `false`.
- `oauth_username_claim` (String) Claim that carries the user's display name. Server default: `name`.
- `openid_end_session_endpoint` (String) Provider end-session (logout) endpoint. Empty means none.
- `openid_provider_url` (String) OIDC discovery URL (`.well-known/openid-configuration`). Empty means no generic OIDC provider is configured.
- `openid_redirect_uri` (String) Redirect URI registered with the provider. Empty lets Open WebUI derive it.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Singleton identifier.
